name: Gameplay fixtures: spell cast counts stay with the creature in its own instance
contract: Creature GUIDs are generated per map, so two fresh Zul'Gurub instances give the same entry summoned at the
same point the same GUID; parallel lanes running one boss scenario hit this. The harness counted casts by GUID
and spell only, so one instance's casts showed up on the other creature. Two solo heroes enter their own
instance at the same point and each summons entry 36 there. The second golem's GUID counter equals the first
one's (checked, so the test still discriminates), the first golem casts Power Word: Fortitude (1243) three
times and the second once, and each golem must read only its own casts.

steps.label: CONTROL: the first hero is in Zul'Gurub
CONTROL: the second hero is in Zul'Gurub
CONTROL: both golems share one GUID
DISCRIMINATING: the first golem counts its own three casts
DISCRIMINATING: the second golem counts its one cast
